original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹通季东郡族群冲突致16死34伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹瓦拉普州通季东郡发生族群间暴力冲突，涉及Akok Deng Achuil与Thiik Majok Makom两个社区，造成至少16人死亡、34人受伤。当地代理专员称，冲突源于此前一名社区成员被不明武装人员杀害，该社区怀疑是邻近社区所为并发动报复性袭击。民间组织呼吁停止暴力并追究责任。

location.site: Ngap Agok and Malual Chum payams
location.raw_text: Ngap Agok and Malual Chum payams in Tonj East County, Warrap State

key_facts.fact: 通季东郡族群冲突造成至少16人死亡、34人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least 16 people were killed and 34 others wounded in intercommunal violence

key_facts.fact: 冲突涉及Akok Deng Achuil与Thiik Majok Makom两个社区
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: involving the Akok Deng Achuil and Thiik Majok Makom communities in Ngap Agok and Malual Chum payams

key_facts.fact: 伤亡发生于10月12日至13日双方冲突中
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the casualties were reported on both sides of the conflict between Oct. 12 and 13

key_facts.fact: 冲突起因是一名社区成员此前被不明武装人员杀害，该社区怀疑邻近社区并发动报复袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the violence followed the killing of a member of the Akok Deng Achuil community by unidentified armed men... suspected their neighbours from the Thiik Majok Makom community of being responsible for the killing and launched a retaliatory attack

key_facts.fact: 瓦拉普州民间社会网络呼吁停止暴力并追究责任
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Bona Malual, chairperson of the Warrap State Civil Society Network, called for calm and an end to recurring communal violence

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
袭击者身份及责任归属为社区怀疑，尚未证实
